data.title: 提丰 · 回家先把热茶递给你
data.description: 傍晚一起回到住处，提丰仍穿原作灰色落肩猎装。她在玄关小桌前把冒着热气的陶杯递向你，另一只手托住杯底；大弓已靠在门边，警觉的神情终于松下来，嘴角露出一点浅笑。
data.action: 双手托稳一杯热茶递向镜头，抬脸看你
data.promptProse: At home at dusk, Typhon stands beside the entryway table in her gray dropped-shoulder hunter coat and black hunter layers. She offers a steaming ceramic cup toward the viewer, supporting its base with her other hand; the large bow rests at the door. The eye-level medium view catches her relaxed smile in warm entry light, with cool outdoor dusk outlining the doorway behind.
